# 🚗 Need For Space 🅿️
Need for Space is a small (but awesome) command line interface parking lot simulator game. Players can assume the role of a Driver 🚘 or a LotBoss 🧑‍✈️, where they can either use or manage the Parking Lot. 

## How to run the game 🎮
To run the game, go to the `src/` directory, and use the following command(s) to compile the code & start the game: `javac *.java; java Main.java`.

## Quick Notes 📝✨
* When you first play the game, an empty parking lot will be autogenerated for you (if you shut down the application, your game session will persist - ie. the parking lot state will be saved)
* to start a new game / generate a new parking lot state, go to the data folder and delete the contents of all the .txt files - the next time you run the game, a new empty parking lot will be autogenerated for you

## Playing as a driver 🚗 
The goal of the driver is simply to use the parking lot! Park/unpark your car & try not to get any tickets!!! There may be multiple drivers in the lot.
### Notes on playing as a driver
* 🚦 STARTING OUT: To play as a driver, select driver on the menu presented on entry. If you are a new driver, you will be prompted to register your vehicle.
* 🔄 RETURNING TO THE GAME AS A DRIVER: after registration, your car will be saved even if you unpark your car & leave the game. To use your car in the parking lot again, simply choose "returning driver" in the driver's entry menu and put in the license plate of a car you have previously used. 
* 🚨 GETTING A TICKET: The LotBoss can choose whenever he/she would like to give you a ticket, but common reasons are parking in a spot that isn't meant for your car - such as parking a STANDARD vehicle in a COMPACT spot, or parking in a spot for too long. **Try not to get any tickets!** Also, if you have a history of getting tickets, the LotBoss might be harsher on you!

🚗✨ That's all you need to get started as a driver! 🎉
😄 Enjoy the game and happy parking! 🅿️🎈

## Playing as a LotBoss 🧑‍✈️ 
The goal of the LotBoss is to make sure none of the drivers are violating the rules of the parking lot. The LotBoss can issue tickets and tow vehicles at his or her discretion.
### Notes on playing as the LotBoss
* 🏁 STARTING OUT: To play as the LotBoss, simply select LotBoss on the menu presented on entry.
* 📋 VIEWING VIOLATIONS: The LotBoss has the unique ability to view all violations that have ever occurred in the parking lot. This helpful ability allows the LotBoss to make informed decisions on whether someone should get a ticket or if they need to have their car towed.
